[To [Elizabeth Barnett](/person/113)]I have been reading an article in the [National Review](/periodical/259), showing how utterly [Carlyle](/person/1972) misquoted Cromwell’s speeches, and absolutely neglected shoals of contemporary papers which would have spoilt his conceptions of his idol. It is curious, but really, poor old Carlyle must have been a good deal of a humbug for all his bluster.
